title: The Trapped Hall
about: Traps and treacherous ground: a scholar wants a wand from the vault of an old hall.

wand.title: The Scholar's Wand
wand.offer: The vault beyond the old hall holds a wand of magic missiles. The builders were fond of traps. Bring it to me and I'll pay 60 gold.
wand.done: Wendel turns the wand over in his ink-stained hands, delighted.

camp.name: The Scholar's Camp
camp.text: A tent pitched before a crumbling stone hall. A scholar pores over a map by the fire.

people.name: Wendel
people.says: Ah, you must be the help I sent for.

hall.name: The Old Hall
hall.text: A long hall of uniform flagstones, half buried under fallen masonry. An iron door stands at the far end.

vault.name: The Vault
vault.text: A small vault. Two skeletons stand guard beside an iron-bound chest with a heavy lock.
